actions.description:
Jewel unleashes a torrent of grating, high-pitched yips. All creatures other than Pavetta within @Template[emanation|distance:20]{20 feet} must attempt a @Check[will|dc:25] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and becomes temporarily immune to Distracting Yipping for 24 hours.

Success The creature takes a -2 status penalty to Perception checks for 1 round.

Failure The creature takes a -4 status penalty to Perception checks and is Off-Guard for 1 round.

Critical Failure As failure, but also, if the creature attempts any concentrate action during the round, they must succeed at a @Check[flat|dc:11] or the action is lost.
actions.name: Distracting Yipping

actions.description: If Jewel damages a Small or larger creature standing on the ground with her jaws Strike, that creature becomes Off-Guard for 1 round (or off-guard and Clumsy 1 for 1 round on a critical hit).
actions.name: Ankle Bite

actions.description: If Pavetta doesn't sustain her Release Jewel action, Jewel can only take Stride actions to return to Pavetta's square. If she's in her square, she takes no actions.
actions.name: Return to Pavetta
